title: FBI-UAP-D009, FD-302-67, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record regarding UAP sightings in the northeastern United States in February 2026, featuring heavy redactions of personal information.

incidents.summary: Witnesses observed two red spherical objects hovering in their backyard, which then moved in tandem and merged.
behavior: moved up and to the left
incidents.quote: described the light as a red sphere that was about one meter in diameter

incidents.summary: Witness observed several white orbs traveling at high altitude over their house.
incidents.quote: saw several white orbs travel over house from the west to the east
